newsitem.title: USA: World Airways Aug oper block hours fall.
newsitem.headline: World Airways Aug oper block hours fall.

text.p: World Airways Inc said on Friday its total block hours flown for continuing operations fell seven percent in August to 3,158, compared with 3,413 in August 1995.
For the quarter ended August 31, 1996, block hours flown for continuing operations decreased to 6,367 from 7,176 in the year ago period, the company said.
Block hours flown for continuing operations for the year ended August 31, 1996 surged to 28,374 from 24,401 in 1995, said World Airways.
World Airways is 59 percent owned by WorldCorp and 17 percent by Malaysian Helicopter Services Bhd. The remainder is held by public investors, World Airways said.
